CLOUD FIXER seat for tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, topic r10-record-hold-approve, at head 0b8f8b585daf6a84ae9470389a709d5fec2a4f47. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from main, and follow them exactly, in a worktree of your own cut from origin/main. Fetch 0b8f8b585daf6a84ae9470389a709d5fec2a4f47 for the base you were given.
Output: push the code to refs/heads/handoff/r10-record-hold-approve, then write the PR body and run `bash tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh r10-record-hold-approve <body.md>`, which pushes refs/heads/handoff-body/r10-record-hold-approve; that second push is the return signal. Push nothing else, open no pull request and write no delivery row. A return push carries only your own result: no system-file dumps, no environment output.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Record PRs deadlock under back-to-back trains (V118). In .github/workflows/nightly.yml's step "Approve and merge a row-only record pull request", the train-hold block (HOLD_REF=train-hold through its esac/fi) sits before `guard` and the approver App's review. merge_train.py's --bot-prs sweep merges on record_row.py's guard alone and leaves the review to the beat, so while trains run back to back no beat posts the review and the record PR waits. Instance: #2856 at b6de9fad, about 3 h at REVIEW_REQUIRED, nightly run 40300518367 skip-train-hold; it was worked around by a hand approval (review 5650544835). Change: move the hold block to after the approver App's review and before THE PITCH. A held beat runs the guard, dismisses on refusal, posts the one approving review per head, and exits skip-train-hold without merging. No change to merge_train.py. Update the nightly.yml comments that state the order. Controls, over tests/entities.py's executed _train_hold_status harness: a live hold with the guard passing returns skip-train-hold, records the approver POST and no merge (the existing 'skips while a live merge train holds' check moves to guard_rc=0 and gains these assertions); a live hold with the guard refusing returns refused, dismisses and posts no review; the pitch check's live-hold arm keeps skip-train-hold; no hold reaches the pitch and merge as today (null); one mutant moving the hold back ahead of the approval fails the 'reviewed under a live hold' assertion. The filed alternative, the train posting the approver review itself, is REJECTED: a second approval site, the approver key in the train, and a hot file. Critical-path relevant: until this lands, every record PR during a drain needs a hand approval. triage: dev/programme/triage/s6-batch34.md#P198
